direct_claims: This chart summarizes how long participants took to learn each of 26 letters, measured in seconds.
The chart is a box plot, so it is comparing distributions rather than just single averages for each letter.
The metadata ties the chart to a paper published at CHI in 2021.
The reported medians vary substantially across letters, with letter o having the lowest median at 20.095 seconds and letter f the highest at 81.526 seconds.
Most letters, specifically 19 of them, have median learning times below 50 seconds.

Letters a, c, and o are described as having small quartile ranges but a few outliers, which suggests that most participants learned them in similar amounts of time but a small number took much longer or shorter than the rest.
Letters f, n, q, and s have large quartile ranges, indicating broader spread in participant learning times for those letters.
Because the only explicit domain story is that this is from a CHI 2021 paper, any stronger claim about policy, industry, or deployment impact would go beyond the provided evidence.
